title: Only man buries
html_source: There have been reports of burial practices by Chimpanzees and magpies by throwing grass and branches over the dead of their kind like the elephants. “Funeral behaviors” were first discovered by Biologist, Nicholas Verbeek in 1972. Although mourning has been observed, research on animal funerals are yet to go beyond simple observation since they are rarely observed.
